goal: POC-05: extend the verified renderer-free WoW 1.12.1 build 5875 Android headless client with player gold + inventory snapshots and guarded mailbox take-money/take-item operations while preserving POC-04 reconnect/keepalive behavior.
notes: POC-05 starts from exact accepted POC-04 SHA 3a6926be6e4ac846ade5724347f1e7df88c79728. It reads PLAYER_FIELD_COINAGE and owned item/container update masks, keeps mailbox read-only by default, and allows take-money/take-item only for an explicit mail_id plus WOW112_MAIL_MUTATION_CONFIRM=YES. COD item collection is blocked. Any disconnect or ambiguous result after mutation send is fail-closed and is not automatically retried; after a server-confirmed mutation, reconnects reconcile mailbox state instead of sending the mutation again. No gameplay result yet.
